name: [G-STAY-05] Get directions and Share hand off to another app; the app comes back @regression
fullName: Guest · Stays and cancellation Stays [G-STAY-05] Get directions and Share hand off to another app; the app comes back @regression
description:
Stays (Guest manual G5) and cancellation (G6).

beforeAll books a fresh instant stay through the app; the cancellation
tests then cancel that same stay through the wizard, which is also this
spec's cleanup (afterAll cancels it through the API if a test failed first).
